title: Tool trust
violates: The expectation that a budget you set bounds the run.
because: Under Pyodide, in a Node harness and in three desktop browsers (Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, not phones), the `timeout` option never returned while `rlimit` cancelled the same query {{run:RUN-phone-pyodide}}. The cause was not established.
class: a budget that does not bound the run

cured_by.text: Budget with `rlimit`, and stop a runaway query from outside by terminating its worker.

also.caption: The same query with the `timeout` option set did not return, and an outside limit stopped it.
